LanguageData.LP_Mem_Undead_Abhorrent_Self.stages.0.de: I personally did something that blasphemes life and death.
LanguageData.LP_Mem_Undead_Abhorrent_Know.stages.0.la: someone in the colony toys with the undead
LanguageData.LP_Mem_Undead_Abhorrent_Know.stages.0.de: Another undead thing has appeared in the colony. It's a blasphemy against life.
I stuffed a soul into a phylactery. It's screaming in there.
A soul was fed to a phylactery and can never go to the land of the dead.
LanguageData.LP_Mem_Undead_Wary_Self.stages.0.label: I used necromancy
LanguageData.LP_Mem_Undead_Wary_Self.stages.0.descrip: This power is useful, but it gives me the creeps.
LanguageData.LP_Mem_Undead_Wary_Know.stages.0.label: the colony used necromancy
LanguageData.LP_Mem_Undead_Wary_Know.stages.0.descrip: I hope they know what they're doing.
LanguageData.LP_Mem_Undead_Sacred_Self.stages.0.label: a step closer to eternity
LanguageData.LP_Mem_Undead_Sacred_Self.stages.0.descr: Death's threshold retreated a little before me.
LanguageData.LP_Mem_Undead_Sacred_Know.stages.0.label: grace of undeath
LanguageData.LP_Mem_Undead_Sacred_Know.stages.0.descr: The colony took another step toward eternity.
LanguageData.LP_Mem_Undead_Sacred_MasterReturns.stage: The lich reshaped its body from the phylactery. Death means nothing to a great being.
LanguageData.LP_Thought_Undead_Lich.stages.0.label: living with a lich
LanguageData.LP_Thought_Undead_Lich.stages.0.descript: A lich lives in the colony.
LanguageData.LP_Thought_Undead_Phylactery.stages.0.de: The colony has a phylactery. Death is not the end.
LanguageData.LP_Mem_Giants_KilledFeared.stages.0.desc: That walking mountain fell, and I'm the one who brought it down.
LanguageData.LP_Mem_Giants_KilledSupreme.stages.0.des: I killed a noble giant with my own hands.
LanguageData.LP_Thought_Giants_Feared.stages.0.label: giants in the colony
LanguageData.LP_Thought_Giants_Feared.stages.0.descri: Something that big could step on me at any moment.
LanguageData.LP_Thought_Giants_Feared.stages.1.label: giants in the colony
LanguageData.LP_Thought_Giants_Feared.stages.1.descri: Something that big could step on me at any moment.
LanguageData.LP_Thought_Giants_Feared.stages.2.label: giants in the colony
LanguageData.LP_Thought_Giants_Feared.stages.2.descri: Something that big could step on me at any moment.
LanguageData.LP_Thought_Giants_Supreme.stages.0.label: born great
LanguageData.LP_Thought_Giants_Supreme.stages.0.descr: I'm a giant. The ordning is on my side.
LanguageData.LP_Thought_Giants_Supreme.stages.1.label: insignificant
LanguageData.LP_Thought_Giants_Supreme.stages.1.descr: Compared to giants, I'm just too small.
LanguageData.LP_Mem_Arcane_Forbidden_Self.stages.0.de: The moment magic flowed through my fingertips, I felt defiled.
LanguageData.LP_Mem_Arcane_Forbidden_Know.stages.0.de: Someone is casting spells in the colony again.
LanguageData.LP_Mem_Arcane_Cautious_Self.stages.0.des: I hope nothing went wrong this time.
LanguageData.LP_Mem_Arcane_Revered_Self.stages.0.desc: Magic flowing through the body feels so good.
LanguageData.LP_Mem_Arcane_Supreme_Self.stages.0.desc: I touched the Weave once again.
LanguageData.LP_Thought_Arcane_Item.stages.0.label: magic items on me
LanguageData.LP_Thought_Arcane_Item.stages.0.descript: I'm carrying something steeped in magic.
LanguageData.LP_Thought_Arcane_Enchanting.stages.0.de: The colony has an enchanting table; magic is respected here.
LanguageData.LP_Thought_Arcane_NotBlessed.stages.0.de: I can't cast spells. In this culture I always feel lesser.
LanguageData.LP_Thought_Races_Human.stages.0.label: pure human
LanguageData.LP_Thought_Races_Human.stages.1.label: impure bloodline
LanguageData.LP_Thought_Races_Human.stages.1.descript: By our creed, my bloodline isn't pure enough.
LanguageData.LP_Thought_Races_Many.stages.0.label: city of many peoples
LanguageData.LP_Thought_Races_Many.stages.0.descripti: The colony is home to many different races; this is how Faerûn should be.
LanguageData.LP_Thought_Races_Own.stages.0.label: pride of my people
LanguageData.LP_Thought_Races_Own.stages.0.descriptio: I belong to the culture's founding people.
LanguageData.LP_Thought_Races_Own.stages.1.label: outsider
LanguageData.LP_Thought_Races_Own.stages.1.descriptio: I don't belong to the culture's founding people.
That mortal climbed another step toward godhood. The gods will bring down punishment.
LanguageData.LP_Mem_Apotheosis_Sacred_Know.stages.0.d: I saw a mortal ascend to a higher divine rank with my own eyes.
LanguageData.LP_Thought_Apotheosis_Demigod.stages.0.d: There's a mortal in the colony who calls themself a demigod.
LanguageData.LP_Thought_Offerings_Unfed.stages.0.desc: Nobody has made an offering at the altar this quarter yet. The gods will be displeased.
LanguageData.LP_Mem_Brain_Abhorrent_Self.stages.0.des: I sucked a person's mind dry. I'm a monster.
LanguageData.LP_Mem_Brain_Sacred_Know.stages.0.label: another mind joins the hivemind
LanguageData.LP_Mem_Brain_Sacred_Know.stages.0.descri: The hivemind has grown a little stronger.
LanguageData.LP_Thought_Brain_ElderBrain.stages.0.des: An elder brain whispers in the colony.
